description: Three real county polygons cut from Census TIGER/Line 2025 COUNTY, for data/pipeline/test_join.py. Nothing was drawn, simplified or edited: the coordinates are the file's, rounded to seven decimals (about 1 cm).
cut: DuckDB 1.4.4 spatial: ST_Read('/vsizip/tl_2025_us_county.zip/tl_2025_us_county.shp', spatial_filter_box := a box around the counties) filtered to the three GEOIDs, written by COPY ... (FORMAT GDAL, DRIVER 'GeoJSON', COORDINATE_PRECISION=7).

records.from: the 2026-10-19 Texas snapshots (nid-dams, nrhp-listed, nces-public-schools), records unmodified, 17 of them
